name: 35757 · Madison, AL
findings: ZIP 35757 (Madison) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35757 (Madison) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 35757 (Madison) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).
